title: Thermo Heracell 150i CO2 incubator
manualMd: Direct-heat humidified CO2 incubator for mammalian cell culture. Set point 37 °C, 5% CO2, 95% humidity. Holds within 0.5 °C and 0.2% CO2 once stable.
hazardsMd:
- High-CO2 atmosphere inside; do not lean head into the chamber.
- Glass inner door is heavy; close gently.

operations.title: Daily check
operations.bodyMd: Confirm temperature, CO2, and humidity readouts are within set range. Check water tray level — top up with sterile water (not tap) if below 1/3 full.

operations.title: Decontamination
operations.bodyMd: Monthly: remove all flasks to a backup incubator. Run the built-in 180 °C decon cycle (~12 hours including cool-down). Replace HEPA filter per manufacturer schedule.

operations.title: Contamination outbreak
operations.bodyMd: All users must check their flasks. The lab manager runs a decon cycle. Switch to backup incubator until confirmed clear. Investigate sourcing — most often a single user's contaminated stock.

operations.title: CO2 won't hold
operations.bodyMd: Check (a) the CO2 tank pressure, (b) the door gasket for tears, (c) the inner-door window seal. After heavy door-opening (e.g. a class), the chamber needs 30+ min to re-equilibrate.

operations.title: Post-use
operations.bodyMd: Close inner glass door fully before the outer door. Don't open multiple shelves at once. Log any flasks added or removed in the incubator logbook.
